title: Sparse private exception repair for harmful HashedNet collisions
dataset: sklearn.load_digits 1.8.0, normalized 8x8 pixel vectors; fixed tensor SHA-256 faf2d98f61250c1cdc0b114323133d3c58da04f5c5d28bb78e4bde3c936a75b1
model: 64->128 ReLU->10 MLP; compressed first-layer matrix only
hypothesis: Allocating one private residual to each duplicate logical connection caused by 2,048-bucket hashing, optionally with a 32-angle Givens Mirror View, recovers most of the quality of a native 4,096-bucket HashedNet at no more actual bytes, and beats same-count random exception placement.
methods: hash2048 plus collision residuals and Givens
hash2048 plus same-count random residuals and Givens
exception_selection: For each deterministic 2,048 map, within each bucket keep the first row-major logical connection in the shared table and allocate a private value for every subsequent connection. Index positions are serialized as uint16 and charged; residual values are FP16. Random control uses the exact same count, deterministic seed, and serialized index dtype.
mirror_coordinate: Learned 32-angle adjacent-pair Givens input View, identity initialized, applied before hashed first-layer projection.

training.initialization: fixed per-seed/method; matched batches per seed and method index
training.batch_order: Same deterministic minibatch index sequence for every method within a seed.

development.selection: No tuning grid; exception selection, model, optimizer, updates and gates fixed before training.

fresh.open_rule: Only if both dev seeds pass all quality, bytes and random-exception gates.

storage.authority: actual NPZ inference payload bytes after serialization and reload
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Only hashed bucket maps are regenerated from paid seed and committed code; exception indices are explicitly serialized and charged.

primary_metrics: comparison to random same-count exceptions and hash4096
success_gate: Both dev seeds: collision-residual+Givens accuracy >= hash2048 +1.0pp and >= same-count random-residual+Givens +1.0pp; within 1.0pp of hash4096; payload <= hash4096; no-view collision residual is reported separately for Mirror attribution.
failure_gate: Any quality or byte gate miss is FAIL; fresh remains sealed. If no-view collision residual matches the Givens variant within 0.5pp, sparse-repair may be useful but the Mirror-specific contribution is not established.
boundaries: Exception count is not logical capacity
Fixed-update learning efficiency is not near-convergence capacity
